card.label: Card
card.description: A single card. Swap it into your deck, replacing a card of your choice.

removal.label: Removal
removal.description: Permanently remove a card of your choice from your deck. Repeatable — the slot never empties.

stickers.label: +1 Rank
stickers.description: +1 card rank (stops at Ace)

stickers.label: −1 Rank
stickers.description: -1 card rank (stops at 2)

stickers.label: +2 Rank
stickers.description: +2 card rank (stops at Ace).

stickers.label: −2 Rank
stickers.description: -2 card rank (stops at 2)

stickers.label: Random Rank
stickers.description: Set to random rank

stickers.label: Random Suit
stickers.description: Change to a random suit ♠♣♥♦

stickers.label: Change to ♠
stickers.description: Change suit to ♠

stickers.label: Change to ♥
stickers.description: Change suit to ♥

stickers.label: Change to ♦
stickers.description: Change suit to ♦

stickers.label: Change to ♣
stickers.description: Change suit to ♣

stickers.label: Same-Safe
stickers.description: Safe if this card lands on a card of the same rank, or a card of the same rank lands on this card

stickers.label: Spade Guard
stickers.description: Safe if this card lands on a ♠, or a ♠ lands on this card

stickers.label: Heart Guard
stickers.description: Safe if this card lands on a ♥, or a ♥ lands on this card

stickers.label: Diamond Guard
stickers.description: Safe if this card lands on a ♦, or a ♦ lands on this card

stickers.label: Club Guard
stickers.description: Safe if this card lands on a ♣, or a ♣ lands on this card

stickers.label: Payout
stickers.description: At deal end → earn coins equal to pile size if this card tops its pile

stickers.label: Bonus Coin
stickers.description: When this card lands → +1 coin

stickers.label: Anchor
stickers.description: At deal end → exclude this pile from the smallest-pile score if this card tops its pile

stickers.label: Bury 1
stickers.description: When this card lands → bury 1 deck card under the pile

stickers.label: Bury 2
stickers.description: When this card lands → bury 2 deck cards under the pile. Costs 7 coins

stickers.label: Last Coin
stickers.description: When this card lands → +5 coins if it kills a pile

stickers.label: Heavy
stickers.description: When placed → +1 toward pile size

stickers.label: Massive
stickers.description: When placed → +2 toward pile size

stickers.label: Collector
stickers.description: When this card lands → +2 coins per other sticker on this card

stickers.label: Compound
stickers.description: When this card lands → +X coins. X starts at 0, grows by 1 per correct placement

stickers.label: Scout
stickers.description: When this card lands → peek at the next deck card

stickers.label: Wild Suit
stickers.description: Counts as every suit

stickers.label: Shuffle
stickers.description: When this card lands → optionally shuffle the pile

stickers.label: Donate
stickers.description: When this card lands → move 1 buried card from this pile to the smallest pile

stickers.label: Quick Bury
stickers.description: When this card lands → bury 1 deck card under the pile

stickers.label: Twin Spark
stickers.description: When this card lands → peek at the next card if another pile's top card matches this rank

stickers.label: Loose Change
stickers.description: When this card lands → +0–3 coins (random)

stickers.label: Snowball Bury
stickers.description: When this card lands → bury X cards. X starts at 0, grows by 1 per correct placement, resets on a wrong guess

stickers.label: Deep Pockets
stickers.description: When this card lands → +1 coin per 10 cards left in the deck

stickers.label: Pillar Scout
stickers.description: When this card lands → peek at the next card if this column has no pillar

stickers.label: Base Scout
stickers.description: When this card lands → peek at the next card if this column has no base

stickers.label: Spade Snob
stickers.description: When a ♠ lands on this card → peek at the next deck card

stickers.label: Heart Snob
stickers.description: When a ♥ lands on this card → +4 coins

stickers.label: Diamond Snob
stickers.description: When a ♦ lands on this card → shuffle all piles

stickers.label: Club Snob
stickers.description: When a ♣ lands on this card → bury 1 deck card under the pile

stickers.label: Heart Choir
stickers.description: When this card lands → +1 coin per other pile with a ♥ top card

stickers.label: Diamond Ripple
stickers.description: When this card lands → shuffle every other pile with a ♦ top card

stickers.label: Club Roots
stickers.description: When this card lands → bury 1 deck card under each pile with a ♣ top card

stickers.label: Spade Whispers
stickers.description: When this card lands → the next X cards show a hint (higher/lower/same), where X = other piles with a ♠ top card

stickers.label: Tell
stickers.description: When this card lands → shows if the next deck card is higher, lower, or same

stickers.label: Recharge Shield
stickers.description: When this card lands correctly → bank a Same Charge (max 1)

stickers.label: Tap Power
stickers.description: When this card lands correctly → fire your equipped Same-Power

stickers.label: Leech
stickers.description: Cursed — when this card lands → −1 coin

stickers.label: Leech Swarm
stickers.description: Cursed — when this card lands → −2 coins

pillars.label: Heart Bonus
pillars.description: When a ♥ lands in this column → +1 coin

pillars.label: Column Tie-Safe
pillars.description: Every pile in this column survives a tie

pillars.label: Guardian
pillars.description: At deal end → +7 coins if every pile in this column survived

pillars.label: 8 Bury
pillars.description: When a ♣ with no stickers lands correctly in this column → bury 1 deck card under that pile

pillars.label: All Hearts
pillars.description: At deal end → +8 coins if every surviving pile in this column has a ♥ top card

pillars.label: Envy
pillars.description: At deal end → +4 coins per pile in this column with a ♥ top card

pillars.label: Streak Size
pillars.description: From the 3rd consecutive correct guess in this column → +1 pile size per guess. Resets on a wrong guess or any guess in another column

pillars.label: Streak Bury
pillars.description: From the 4th consecutive correct guess in this column → bury 1 deck card per guess. Resets on a wrong guess or any guess in another column

pillars.label: Second Wind
pillars.description: The first pile to die in this column is saved — but all its buried cards return to the deck

pillars.label: Greedy
pillars.description: At deal end → +20 coins if every pile in this column survived and no other pillar is on the board

pillars.label: Fibonacci
pillars.description: When a Fibonacci-rank card (A/2/3/5/8) lands correctly into this column → +1 coin

pillars.label: Highest Heart
pillars.description: At deal end → earn coins equal to the highest numbered ♥ top card in this column (2–10 face value, Ace pays 1, royals pay 0)

pillars.label: Dense Bury
pillars.description: When a ♣ with 2+ stickers lands correctly in this column → bury 1 deck card under that pile

pillars.label: Revive
pillars.description: When a pile in this column reaches 10 cards → revive one dead pile on the board

pillars.label: Insurance
pillars.description: At deal end → +20 coins if only one pile is alive board-wide and it's in this column

pillars.label: Ditto
pillars.description: Mirrors the center column's pillar

pillars.label: Massive Diamond
pillars.description: ♦ cards in this column count as +2 toward pile size

pillars.label: Prime
pillars.description: When a prime-rank card (2/3/5/7) lands correctly in this column → +1 coin

pillars.label: Queen's Eye
pillars.description: When a royal ♠ (J/Q/K) lands correctly in this column → peek at the next card

pillars.label: Shuffler
pillars.description: When a ♦ lands in this column → shuffle the other piles in this column

pillars.label: Excavator
pillars.description: At deal end → +2 coins per buried card in this column's largest pile with a ♥ top card

pillars.label: Gambler
pillars.description: At deal end → 50/50: +10 coins or nothing (requires a ♥ top card in this column)

pillars.label: Last Rites
pillars.description: When a pile in this column dies → peek at the next card

pillars.label: Static
pillars.description: When a ♠ lands in this column → 50% chance to peek at the next card

pillars.label: Wild Aces
pillars.description: Aces count as high or low when landing in this column

pillars.label: Diamond Anchor
pillars.description: At deal end → exclude any pile in this column with a ♦ top card from the smallest-pile score

pillars.label: Diamond Distribution
pillars.description: When a ♦ lands in this column → redistribute all piles in this column to equal size

bases.label: Kamikaze
bases.description: Kill a random ♠-topped pile in this column, then peek the next 3 cards

bases.label: Spade Peeker
bases.description: Peek the next X cards, where X = piles in this column with a ♠ top card

bases.label: Upheaval
bases.description: Shuffle every pile in this column

bases.label: Phoenix
bases.description: Revive a random dead pile in this column with one fresh card (buried cards return to the deck)

bases.label: Wild Sticker
bases.description: Apply a random sticker to a random top card in this column

bases.label: Ballast
bases.description: Redistribute all piles in this column to equal size

bases.label: Cast
bases.description: Permanently set every top card's rank in this column to the bottom pile's rank

bases.label: Suit Setter
bases.description: Permanently set every top card's suit in this column to the bottom pile's suit

bases.label: Sticker Harvest
bases.description: Choose a pile → bury 2 deck cards per sticker on its top card, then peel all those stickers

bases.label: Reactor
bases.description: Recharge your other two bases (never another Reactor)

bases.label: Club Dig
bases.description: Bury 1 deck card under each ♣-topped pile in this column

bases.label: Demolish
bases.description: Choose a pillar → destroy it permanently, then peek the next 2 cards

bases.label: Heart Demolish
bases.description: Destroy every ♥-topped pile in this column. +7 coins per pile destroyed

bases.label: Heart Tax
bases.description: +1 coin per ♥ card in this column (top + buried, dead piles excluded)

bases.label: Power Surge
bases.description: Fire your Same-Power on a random pile in this column

samePowers.label: Burrow
samePowers.description:
Trigger: You make a correct Same
Effect: Bury 1 card under every alive pile

samePowers.label: Rekindle
samePowers.description:
Trigger: You make a correct Same
Effect: Revive the largest dead pile on the board

samePowers.label: Dividend
samePowers.description:
Trigger: You make a correct Same
Effect: Gain 1 coin for each alive pile on the board

samePowers.label: Link Shuffler
samePowers.description:
Trigger: You make a correct Same
Effect: Shuffle every alive pile

samePowers.label: Same Peeker
samePowers.description:
Trigger: You make a correct Same
Effect: Peek at the next upcoming card

samePowers.label: Same Heavy
samePowers.description:
Trigger: You make a correct Same
Effect: Add +1 pile size to every alive pile, and another +5 to the pile you called Same on

packs.label: Large Card Pack
packs.description: Reveals 5 random cards. Keep 2 to swap into your deck before a deal, replacing a card of your choice.

packs.label: Small Card Pack
packs.description: Reveals 3 random cards. Keep 1 to swap into your deck before a deal, replacing a card of your choice.

packs.label: Small Sticker Pack
packs.description: Reveals 3 random stickers. Keep 1 to add to a card.

packs.label: Large Sticker Pack
packs.description: Reveals 5 random stickers. Keep 2 for your inventory. The rest are discarded.
